browser.articlePopulationExposure: Authored dates only; exact serving and publication/redirect intervals unestablished.

sourceCrossReferences.contract: Dated annotations retain context beside historical charts.
sourceCrossReferences.application: Profile/source/exposure context belongs beside descriptive resource comparisons; annotations do not prove causality.

sourceCrossReferences.contract: Search performance distinguishes clicks, impressions, queries, aggregation and preliminary/unavailable data.
sourceCrossReferences.application: Resource event trends cannot supply search queries, impressions, demand or missing account figures.

sourceCrossReferences.contract: EXPORT_SQL selects reader_kind=browser with explicit observed-at bounds.
sourceCrossReferences.application: Stored kind in minimal weekly inputs follows the saved selector, not an absent exported column.

sourceCrossReferences.contract: Explicit singular role/parent registry; selected/included history and exact path matching.
sourceCrossReferences.application: Four complete-week roles reconcile without converting evidence requests into article events.

review.scope: Independent read-only review of saved windows and interpretation; no new tests or production access.
findings: Use production report-first.body; native-report.json in that archive is synthetic preflight.
Adjacent all-kind suffixes have unequal durations and changed profiles; equal raw totals are not a trend.
Equal null/missing method stamps cannot qualify stable measurement. Equal recorded stamps are provenance, not authentication of execution.
Date-only publication labels and newer zero rows cannot supply exact exposure or zero demand.
Aggregate native agreement does not refresh historical owner flags or prove unchanged row membership.

limits: Browser-selected history does not represent all-category history or recover events not stored by earlier rules.
Equal complete-week duration permits descriptive event comparisons, not a stable measurement population or causal growth inference.
Null stamps remain unknown; same stamps are provenance, not evidence of stable delivery, classification or audience.
Evidence-page requests are separate reach outcomes, not article views or proof of use.
Authored calendar dates cannot supply exact publication exposure; no per-hour/day age-normalized demand is produced.
Saved owner links are not refreshed. Referrer sensitivity is not an exclusion or authenticity verdict.
